messages:
sophia.fin: Heads up — received reseller invoice from CloudEdge (invoice CE-2026-07). Line items show 1,200 units billed as `on-demand` instead of our committed dimension. That flips price tiers and increases our liability by roughly $12,420. aws_marketplace_order_id: amzn-ord-0A1B2C. Can we triage?

omar.partnerops: can you drop the line-item CSV or a screenshot? want to confirm mapping quickly.

sophia.fin: Uploaded recon sheet: https://drive.redwood/recon/CE-2026-07.csv
```
line_item_id,dimension,quantity,unit_price,extended
li-001,on_demand,1200,1.50,1800
li-002,storage_gb,500,0.02,10
```

jordan.revops: that order is on channel contract CP-1234 — committed pricing applies. The amount should have been billed under dimension `commit_quantity` with discounted unit_price 0.55. Rough calc: (1.50 - 0.55) * 1200 = $1,140 difference on that line but partner pro rated tiers push total to ~$12.4k across linked invoices. Need to confirm full linked invoice set.

elaine.ap: If partner mis-tagged metering dimension, AP needs a vendor credit request and internal memo. What GL should we post credits to?

jordan.revops: Use GL 4501 "Marketplace & Reseller Credits" for now. We'll require a partner-signed correction and AWS marketplace re-issuance before final reversal.

aws-billing-bot: Automated alert — metering-dimension anomaly detected for invoice CE-2026-07. Suggested action: open AWS Marketplace billing case with evidence.

omar.partnerops: pinged partner rep (cc: @cloudedge-billing). Partner acknowledges export bug in their billing ETL and says they'll re-export. Asked them to include the original order ids and the commit contract reference CP-1234.

sophia.fin: I opened AWS case 1234567890 with support team. Attached CSV and partner's admission. Waiting on AWS to accept re-issuance or provide guidance for partner-side credits.

nina.cfo: provisional approval to record a contra-charge / provisional credit up to $12,500 pending AWS confirmation. Add audit trail item and tag `retro-commit-credit`. Finance needs a signed partner correction to finalize.

elaine.ap: Will create provisional credit memos: PC-9876 for $12,420, code GL 4501. Will queue it for next AR cycle. Once AWS confirms we'll post the final reversal.

omar.partnerops: partner says corrected invoice will be issued by EOD Friday. I'll follow up and post the corrected invoice here.

jordan.revops: once we have corrected invoice, I'll re-run the allocation for channel booking and update revenue deferrals. Heads-up to Revenue Ops: expect a small adjustment to July MRR.

sophia.fin: tagging in casework: internal note -> "CE-2026-07 meter dim mismatch; provisional credit PC-9876 applied; AWS case 1234567890; partner to re-issue." I'll attach final docs when available.

nina.cfo: thanks — make sure Legal has the partner admission email on file. Approving provisional booking but hold cash movement until partner/AWS finalizes.

elaine.ap: noted. I'll add Legal and keep the credit as provisional.

sophia.fin: closing the loop here — will update by Fri. If partner misses EOD, Omar please escalate to channel manager. :exclamation:
